function: LSTM and GNN map received pilots to RIS sensing vectors, downlink RIS reflection coefficients and beamformer power allocations, maximizing the minimum user rate (p. 5-7).
system: Narrowband TDD MU-MISO: AP with 8 antennas, passive reflecting RIS 10x10=100 elements, 3 single-antenna mobile UEs, 1 GHz carrier, 10 MHz bandwidth (p. 3, 8).
method: LSTM state summarizer plus GNN, trained offline unsupervised (Adam, negative minimum-rate loss over U=20 unrolled frames); fixed-point power refinement at inference (p. 7-9).
data_channel: Custom simulator: Rayleigh AP-UE links, Rician (factor 10) AP-RIS and RIS-UE links, Gauss-Markov time correlation, UEs at 10 m/s; 6400 random samples per epoch (p. 8-9).
test_conditions: Trained with U=20 frames of random UE trajectories; tested on random trajectories, including frames beyond 20; L, M, Nr varied in separate evaluations (p. 9-11).
baselines: BCD with perfect CSI [3] and random RIS (non-learned); GNN with fixed sensing [24] and GNN-LSTM without active sensing [6], [18], [24] (learned) (p. 9-10).
metrics: Average minimum downlink user rate per frame (bps/Hz), percentage of BCD perfect-CSI rate, array responses and SINR maps for interpretation (p. 10-13).
complexity: Inference complexity O(Kd^2 + Kd*eta + (K+Nr L)*kappa + (K+2)^2*sigma*D) per frame; hidden size 512 (p. 9, 12); no runtime or FLOPs reported.
q1_support: p. 8: "mobile UEs are modeled by the Rayleigh fading as:"; Rician AP-RIS and RIS-UE links with own path loss (p. 9), a custom simulator, no 3GPP model, DeepMIMO or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 11: "transmission frames beyond 20, despite being trained with"; only the horizon exceeds the 20 training frames, channel model, geometry, K, M and Nr stay the same, and the L, M, Nr sweeps do not state a transfer without retraining.
q3_support: p. 10: "GNN with Fixed Sensing Scheme [24]" (learned) and "the proposed framework performs the best" on minimum rate, Fig. 9; p. 9: "BCD with Perfect CSI [3]" (non-learned), the proposed reaches 94% of it (p. 10).
q4_support: p. 12: "computational complexity for the proposed active sensing unit"; gives O(Kd^2 + Kd*eta + (K+Nr L)*kappa + (K+2)^2*sigma*D) per frame at inference, no runtime or FLOPs.
q5_support: p. 1: "The source code for the numerical results in this paper is available at" https://github.com/HanHanCoding/MUTracking-ActiveSensing; the channel data are simulated on the fly.
notes: Included, area 3: the main metric is the minimum downlink user rate and the learned LSTM+GNN outputs RIS phases (sensing and data stages) and beamformer power allocations; explicit channel estimation is bypassed (p. 4), so area 2 was not chosen. The fixed-point power refinement at inference is analytic, not learned (p. 8). q2 is borderline and marked 0: the only unseen condition is the horizon beyond the 20 training frames (p. 11, also p. 2), with the same channel model, geometry, K, M and Nr; the reviewer may reconsider. PDF is the arXiv v3 of 11 Nov 2024, which states that it was accepted in IEEE TWC (p. 1).
